C. 6.733

{"path":"mix_pH.phrq","new_content":"SOLUTION 1 River
    temp 25
    pH 6.0
    units mg/L
    Cl 10

SOLUTION 2 Seawater_simple
    temp 25
    pH 8.1
    units mg/L
    Cl 19000

MIX 1
    1 0.7
    2 0.3

SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -high_precision true
    -pH true
END
"}
